title: It's plastic, BUT that's good
text: It's plastic, BUT that's good. Ok... it's "vinyl"... it does have a little sheen to it, but honestly, I bought it protect my custom built table.  I have a white cloth underneath and the vinyl cloth on top.  Because it's vinyl it doesn't let "wet" get through.  They don't last forever, but I think they last a fairly decent amount of time. I throw mine in the washer, hang dry them and put them back on.  I do this for about 4-6 months and then they need to be replaced.  I consider it an investment in protecting my table, although I would have given 5 stars for a little better pricing.  The lace pattern is fairly large and isn't completely flat, but I haven't had issues with glasses or other items on the table being "wobbly."  There is some "texure" to the lace pattern.  There are not any "holes" in the pattern so it is an effective moisture barrier.  Hope this helps!
